name: Smith's Grocery Distribution Center Layton UT

fieldNotes.site: Smith's (Kroger division) Layton regional grocery distribution campus on the east side of N Sugar St, between the BNSF/UTA rail corridor (NE/E) and a residential subdivision (S). Confirmed by the 'Smith's' wordmark on the white-and-red warehouse and Smith's-branded trailers in Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. The main truck/yard entrance off N Sugar St (~41.0651, -111.9858) is a wide, open paved driveway with NO barrier arm and NO sliding/swing gate across the truck lane (Street View 2022-11, multiple headings looking E down the drive). The campus is ringed with chain-link fence and trailers along the Sugar St frontage, but the entry drive itself is uncontrolled. A secondary office/shop driveway further south (~41.0635) is also open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed guard booth set astride the entry lane in any Street View frame; a small reddish sign/structure sits beside the drive but is not a multi-window booth controlling traffic.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE because there is no truck gate at all (gate must exist for remoteGs).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large interior paved yard between the Sugar St entrance and the dock faces gives ample on-site queuing room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach across the central yard easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: FALSE. Expansive interior paved yard absorbs any inbound queue; trucks do not stack onto Sugar St.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+. Long continuous dock-door rows with trailers backed in along the south faces of the north warehouses plus the south/refrigerated buildings; total well over 100 doors across the multi-building campus (estimate ~130).
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. Hundreds of trailers parked in marked rows across the central drop yard and a second south drop yard; estimate ~220 trailers visible, ~350 capacity.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on multiple separate buildings/faces (north grocery warehouse vs south refrigerated building) indicate physically separated ship/receive operations.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of ~6 distinct large buildings (north solar-roof warehouses, south refrigerated DC, central/SW shop and office structures).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban — within the Layton / Salt Lake City metro industrial fabric, immediately bordered by a residential subdivision to the south and dense industrial parks to the west.
fieldNotes.railServed: Mainline rail (BNSF/UTA corridor) runs diagonally along the NE/E edge of the property, but no clear spur enters the yard in the imagery; marked FALSE / uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad resolved in the imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two open vehicle entrances off N Sugar St (main yard drive ~41.0651 and a southern office/shop drive ~41.0635); neither is a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~58 acres for the fenced operational campus derived from the perimeter polygon (bounded W by Sugar St, E by the rail corridor, S by residential).

citations.claim: Kroger corporate logistics page lists Smiths DC at 500 Sugar Street, Layton UT 84041 with active work-in line.

verification.rationale: Kroger logistics page lists Layton Smiths DC by exact address; Smiths wordmark on building corroborates; no closure/WARN found.
